title: Made this in my spare time over a week.
author: ryry1237
selftext:
About \~15 years ago I remember playing an old Kongregate game with a similar premise, shoot projectiles at incoming asteroids and instead of destroying them, you deflect the asteroids. I can't recall the game name anymore, so I tried to recreate my favorite parts of it from memory (with a few personal touches)

This was made with the Astrocade default AI tool, using Suno for background music. Did some hand touching up of the default generated assets, but mostly to ensure line widths are consistent. 

The Astrocade default AI tool is a little... simple compared to most commercial tools. While most AI coding tools respond to you with a ton of information, the Astrocade tool seems to respond with as little technical detail as it can get away with. It does seem pretty well oriented for game-making though, and can usually scrap together a good enough base on its first shot to build off of, and it seems much more aware of UI placement compared to other more general purpose tools.

Probably the biggest advantage is that I can make all my change requests through commands on my phone without complex setup or github integration. So yeah, I can now dev on the toilet.

You can play the game here!   
[https://www.astrocade.com/games/astro-bounce/01KR226KAKSVJ1JQ9B9SJ4G2A2?sharedByCreator=maximtsai&surface=web](https://www.astrocade.com/games/astro-bounce/01KR226KAKSVJ1JQ9B9SJ4G2A2?sharedByCreator=maximtsai&surface=web)
